notes: One hour ahead, the last reading is still better (6.7 vs 7.4). In October and November, "same hour yesterday" matches it 7-24 h ahead (19.4 vs 19.5). It also tends to read a little low (bias -4.1).
After calibration, the 80% range held the real value 84% of the time (before: 76%).

CAMS is the official global forecast. Its archive keeps the latest run for each hour, not true 1-3 day forecasts, so both CAMS rows are flattering at long range. Bias-corrected = a per-city linear fit on training data only.
